meta.method: Synthetic control (Abadie/Gardeazabal). Donor weights solved on pre-2014 data only; the counterfactual is the weighted donor path projected forward. Inference by in-place placebo permutation, standardised by pre-treatment RMSPE.
meta.caveat: The counterfactual is 'India without the 2014 structural break', estimated from comparator countries. It is not a forecast of any individual's policies.
sources: IRENA via Our World in Data

variants.spec: Home Ministry totals, counterfactual held flat

security.variantsNote: Annual averages, so the ten-year and eleven-year windows compare like with like: 2,020 deaths a year across 2004-2013 against 690 across 2014-2024. Averaging the eleven Home Ministry parameters individually gives -66.0%, within a fifth of a point. Two things to carry with it. The pre-2014 window contains the mid-2000s peak, and against the three years immediately before 2014 the same seven parameters average -1%, because Kashmir turned back up while the two insurgencies kept falling. And this is arithmetic on India's own totals — there is no comparator and no placebo test. The one security measure with a cross-country counterfactual behind it, UCDP battle deaths against 27 comparators, returns +6.5% at rank 25/36, p = 0.694.
